senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Zadok, 1) the high priest under David and Solomon.
the high priest under David and Solomon.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 21a:1">Snh. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מה צ׳ מחצה וכ׳</he> as Z. (the high priest) takes one half of the show-bread &c.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:4:4">Koh. R. to I, 4</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Chronicles 6:34">I Chr. VI, 34</cite>) <he>ללמדך אילו היה אהרן … צ׳ היה וכ׳</he> to teach thee that if Aaron and his sons had been alive (in David’s days), Z. would have been their superior in his time; a. e.

senses.gloss: Z., an alleged disciple of Antigonos of Sokho, and founder of the sect of the Sadducees.
units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 5:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. V</cite>.—3) R. Z., a Tannai, contemporary with the destruction of the Temple.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:5">Ab. IV, 5</cite>; a. fr.—V. Fr. Darkhé, p. 70 sq.
